AUTHORIZED PUBLICATION

Robotics researcher in UCLA's Robotics and Mechanisms Laboratory, working on DexDirect — a more efficient, scalable approach to collecting demonstrations and training policies for dexterous robotic hands.

  • Led kinesthetic design and prototyping for direct-guidance demonstration collection on dexterous hands (e.g. MIDAS)
  • Recorded task demonstrations across image, state, and tactile observations and trained a neural network policy via imitation learning
  • Monitored policy rollout on hardware and tuned executor-side firmware to leverage prediction consistency

B.J. Kim*, S.J. Wang, et al. — DexDirect: Direct Kinesthetic Arm Guidance for Efficient Dexterous Demonstration Collection. Approved for 2026 IEEE-RAS 25th International Conference on Humanoid Robots on Oct. 7, 2026.
